title: Dana I Beta 11 stuck in pairing Loop
symptom: After changing to a Pixel phone and restoring settings, the user entered the wrong PIN while pairing the pump. The pump is now stuck in a pairing loop and cannot pair to AAPS, even after clearing Bluetooth stacks and restarting the phone.
evidence_quote: I changed the settings in developer to 1.3 for AVRCP. it finally connected then I went to pair to the car and the whole phone reset and crashed.
